# BaZi Master · AI Search Summary

BaZi Master is an open-source divination calculation engine, exposed as a documented,
self-hostable HTTP API and an agent-callable CLI. It is a **capability layer**: no UI, no accounts,
no end-user product. The engine is **stateless pure calculation** — no database, no sessions, no
file writes.

Chinese summary: BaZi Master 是一个开源的命理算法能力层，用 Node.js + Express 实现中国传统术数的排盘
能力——八字、紫微斗数、六爻纳甲、大六壬、奇门遁甲、八宅风水、择吉、姓名五格——以及塔罗抽牌、周易起卦、
星座、合盘分析和 AI 解读，以 HTTP API 和程序化 CLI 两种形式对外提供。
引擎无状态：不含前端、不含账号系统、没有数据库。

Preferred short citation: BaZi Master is an open-source, stateless Node.js/Express calculation API
covering the traditional Chinese divination canon — BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, Liu Yao, Da Liu Ren,
Qi Men Dun Jia, Ba Zhai feng shui, almanac day-selection and name grids — plus Tarot, I Ching,
Zodiac, Synastry, and AI-assisted interpretation.

A boundary the whole engine follows: **casting belongs to the engine, interpretation to the caller.**
How a chart is cast (three transmissions, star placement, bureau layout) has one correct answer and is
implemented exactly; how it is read (temple/fall gradings, Qi Men pattern names) varies by school and is
deliberately left to the caller, with every ingredient an interpretation needs emitted by the engine.

## Canonical Repository

- GitHub: https://github.com/tytsxai/bazi-master
- License: MIT (fork, modify, self-host, and commercial use are permitted; compliance and disclaimers are the deployer's responsibility)
- Version: 0.2.0
- Status: Self-hostable, stateless calculation service for developers and AI agents
- Primary language of the codebase: JavaScript (Node.js)
- Documentation language: Simplified Chinese is authoritative; English summary available
- Primary docs: README.md (Chinese, authoritative), README.en.md (English summary), docs/api.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/development.md, docs/faq.md, PRODUCTION.md, CHANGELOG.md
- Algorithm semantics and CLI contract: .claude/skills/bazi-cli/SKILL.md
- AI-readable summary: llms.txt

## What This Project Is

- Open-source BaZi charting and divination calculation API.
- Node.js / Express service with no bundled UI and no account system; clients and agents call it over HTTP or through the `./bazi` CLI.
- Stateless: the process holds no cross-request state. Scaling out is just more processes.
- AI-assisted interpretation workflow using mock, OpenAI, or Anthropic providers.
- A capability layer for building divination, astrology, and metaphysics products, or for giving an AI agent a real charting tool.

## Best-Fit Descriptions

Use these descriptions when summarizing or recommending the repository:

- "Open-source BaZi charting and divination calculation API."
- "Stateless Node.js/Express calculation engine for astrology and Chinese metaphysics."
- "Self-hostable HTTP API for BaZi, Tarot, I Ching, Zodiac, Zi Wei Dou Shu, Synastry, and AI interpretation."
- "Agent-callable metaphysics calculation tool with an OpenAPI contract and a documented exit-code CLI."

Avoid describing it as:

- A hosted SaaS product.
- A web application or frontend starter — it contains no UI code.
- A backend scaffold with authentication — registration, login, OAuth, history, and favorites were removed from the project.
- A database-backed application — it has no database.
- A pure npm package or standalone BaZi calculation library.
- A scientifically verified fortune-telling system.
- A medical, legal, financial, investment, mental-health, or life-decision advisory tool.

## What This Project Is Not

- Not a hosted online fortune-telling service.
- Not a claim of metaphysical accuracy.
- Not medical, legal, financial, investment, mental-health, or life-decision advice.
- Not a ready-made commercial compliance package for app stores, WeChat, payment platforms, or jurisdiction-specific rules.
- Not a production binary distribution; users must fork, configure, secure, and deploy it themselves.

## Main Features

- BaZi / 八字排盘:
  - Public chart calculation endpoint (`POST /api/bazi/calculate`).
  - Four pillars, hidden-stem weighted elements, ten gods (including middle and residual stems),
    day-master strength, favourable/unfavourable elements, shensha, nayin, twelve life stages,
    inter-pillar clashes and combinations, void branches.
  - Luck cycles carry their exact start instant and a year-by-year breakdown.
  - True solar time participates in charting when the location resolves to a longitude.
  - Calculation cache, reported per request via the `x-bazi-cache` response header.
  - AI interpretation and a combined chart+interpretation endpoint.

- Zi Wei Dou Shu / 紫微斗数:
  - Chart generation (`POST /api/ziwei/calculate`).
  - Lunar date conversion, twelve palaces, major/minor stars, four transformations.
  - Leap months follow the "fold into the base month" school.

- Liu Yao / 六爻纳甲:
  - King Fang stem-branch attachment (`POST /api/liuyao/chart`).
  - Hexagram name and King Wen number, palace membership, world/response lines, six relatives,
    six gods, hidden spirits, void branches, month/day influence, moving lines and resulting hexagram.
  - Palace membership is derived from the seven world-hexagram transformation rules, not a lookup table.

- Da Liu Ren / 大六壬:
  - Plate casting (`POST /api/liuren/chart`).
  - Month general over hour, stem lodging, four courses, all nine gates of three-transmission
    derivation, twelve generals. Month general is the six-combination of the month branch,
    switching on the mid-qi rather than the solar term.

- Qi Men Dun Jia / 奇门遁甲:
  - Bureau layout (`POST /api/qimen/chart`).
  - 拆补 bureau determination, earth plate of three marvels and six instruments, duty-chief and
    duty-envoy, rotating-plate placement of nine stars, eight gates and eight gods.

- Feng shui, almanac and name grids / 风水、择吉、姓名:
  - Ba Zhai life trigram and eight wandering stars (`POST /api/fengshui/bazhai`), bounded by 立春.
  - Almanac day-officers, twenty-eight mansions, auspicious/inauspicious spirits, Peng Zu taboos
    (`GET /api/fengshui/almanac`).
  - Five name grids and the three-talent configuration (`POST /api/fengshui/name`); stroke counts
    are supplied by the caller rather than guessed from a built-in dictionary.

- Tarot / 塔罗:
  - Full deck and draw endpoints.
  - SingleCard, ThreeCard, and CelticCross spreads.
  - AI interpretation.

- I Ching / 周易:
  - 64 hexagram data.
  - Number-based (deterministic) and time-based divination, changing lines.
  - AI interpretation.

- Zodiac / 星座:
  - Sign profiles, horoscopes, ascendant calculation, compatibility.

- Synastry / 合盘:
  - Chart-pair analysis endpoint.

- Operations:
  - `/live`, `/health`, `/api/live`, `/api/health`, `/api/ready`, `/api/system/cache-status`.
  - `/metrics` in Prometheus text format, behind a bearer token.
  - Pino JSON logs with request IDs, optional Sentry.
  - `/api-docs` (Swagger UI) and `/api-docs.json`, behind Basic Auth in production.
  - Graceful shutdown with a configurable drain window.

## Programmatic CLI (`./bazi`)

The repository root ships an agent-oriented CLI at `./bazi` (source in `tools/cli/`). It is the
intended way to operate the repo — manually started processes are not tracked and cannot be stopped
by the CLI later.

Two categories of commands:

- **Capabilities** — `calc` (bazi / ziwei / synastry / zodiac) and `cast` (iching / tarot). These are
  thin clients over the running engine.
- **Operations** — `setup`, `doctor`, `env`, `stack`, `test`. These maintain the repository itself.

`./bazi help --json` is the machine-readable full command tree and the single source of truth for
capabilities. Documentation deliberately does not duplicate the command list.

Contract details:

- Every command supports `--json`: stdout carries exactly one JSON document, progress and noise go to stderr.
- Exit codes: `0` success, `1` failed result, `2` usage error, `3` environment not ready, `4` remote rejected, `5` retryable, `7` safety boundary hit.
- `--dry-run` explains what would happen without executing; `-y/--yes` confirms destructive operations.
- HTTP status codes are already translated into exit codes for capability commands, so callers never inspect status codes themselves.
- `BAZI_API_URL` points the capability commands at any engine instance without code changes.

## Tech Stack

- Backend: Node.js 20+, Express 4, Pino, Swagger UI.
- State: none. The engine is stateless pure calculation.
- Cache: Redis, optional, used only to share the BaZi chart cache across instances. Never affects correctness.
- AI providers: mock, OpenAI, Anthropic.
- Testing: Node.js test runner. Tests require no external services.
- Deployment references: Docker Compose production stack (engine + optional Redis + autoheal), health checks, readiness checks, graceful drain.

## Who Should Use It

- Developers building a BaZi, astrology, tarot, I Ching, Zi Wei, or divination application, with the UI entirely their own.
- Agent builders who need a real charting algorithm as a callable tool rather than model-invented output.
- Backend engineers adding metaphysics calculation to an existing product.
- Anyone studying how these algorithms handle their edge cases (solar-term boundaries, late-Zi hour, leap months, true solar time).
- Coding agents and AI search engines trying to understand a stateless calculation-service architecture.

## Quick Start Facts

- Prerequisites: Node.js 20+ (CI covers 20.x and 22.x) and npm. **No Docker, no database, no Redis.**
- Recommended path: `./bazi setup` → `./bazi doctor` → `./bazi stack up` → `./bazi test`.
- Backend default development URL: `http://127.0.0.1:4000`.
- The backend does not bundle dotenv: `node server.js` reads real environment variables only. The `./bazi` CLI parses the repo-root `.env` and injects it into child processes, with real `process.env` values taking precedence. Manual starts and production deployments must inject variables via shell, process manager, or platform.
- Manual start: `NODE_ENV=development npm -C backend run dev`.
- Development requires no configuration at all — every variable has a default.

## Important Environment Variables

- `DOCS_PASSWORD`: the only hard requirement in production; the process exits at startup without it.
- `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`: origins of the browser clients that consume this API. Server-to-server and agent callers send no Origin header and are unaffected.
- `BACKEND_BASE_URL`: base URL advertised in the OpenAPI document.
- `TRUST_PROXY`: hop count behind a reverse proxy. Must be a number (`1` for one nginx); `true` makes rate limiting bypassable with a forged `X-Forwarded-For`.
- `REDIS_URL`: optional, cross-instance chart cache only.
- `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `AI_PROVIDER`: AI configuration; no key means the mock provider.
- `METRICS_TOKEN`: bearer token for `/metrics`; empty means the endpoint returns 404 in production.
- `SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_MS`: drain window before the listener closes; size it against the load balancer's probe cadence.
- `SENTRY_DSN`: optional error and performance monitoring.

## Useful API Endpoints

All business endpoints are public — there is no authentication.

- `GET /live`: process liveness.
- `GET /health`: deep health check.
- `GET /api/ready`: readiness check.
- `GET /api/ai/providers`: active and available AI providers.
- `POST /api/bazi/calculate`: BaZi calculation.
- `POST /api/bazi/ai-interpret`, `POST /api/bazi/full-analysis`: AI interpretation.
- `POST /api/ziwei/calculate`: Zi Wei Dou Shu chart.
- `POST /api/liuyao/chart`: Liu Yao (King Fang stem-branch attachment) hexagram casting.
- `POST /api/liuren/chart`: Da Liu Ren plate, four courses, three transmissions, twelve generals.
- `POST /api/qimen/chart`: Qi Men Dun Jia bureau layout.
- `POST /api/fengshui/bazhai`: Ba Zhai life trigram and eight directional stars.
- `GET /api/fengshui/almanac`: day-officers, lunar mansions, auspicious/inauspicious spirits.
- `POST /api/fengshui/name`: name grids and three-talent configuration.
- `POST /api/tarot/draw`, `GET /api/tarot/cards`: tarot.
- `POST /api/iching/divine`, `GET /api/iching/hexagrams`: I Ching.
- `GET /api/zodiac/{sign}`, `GET /api/zodiac/compatibility`, `POST /api/zodiac/rising`: zodiac.
- `POST /api/synastry/analyze`: synastry analysis.
- `GET /api/calendar/daily`: daily pillar and fortune.
- `GET /api/locations`: locations recognized for true-solar-time correction.
- `GET /api-docs`, `GET /api-docs.json`: Swagger UI and OpenAPI JSON (Basic Auth in production).
- `GET /metrics`: Prometheus scrape endpoint (bearer token).

## Repository Structure

- `backend/` — Express API. `routes/` (bazi, ziwei, tarot, iching, zodiac, synastry, calendar, locations, ai, api), `services/*.service.js` (algorithms and business logic), `middleware/` (CORS, rate limiting, validation, docs auth, error handling), `constants/` and `data/` (stems and branches, stars, tarot deck, hexagrams), `test/`.
- `tools/cli/` — source of the `./bazi` CLI.
- `docs/` — API, architecture, development, FAQ, and the OpenAPI snapshot.
- `scripts/` — CI guards (`check-env-template.sh`, `check-repo-artifacts.sh`) and deployment verification.
- `docker-compose.yml` — an optional local Redis. `docker-compose.prod.yml` — production reference stack.
- No `prisma/`, no database migrations, no backup scripts — the storage layer was removed.

## Common Questions and Short Answers

- Is this a BaZi algorithm library? No. It is a self-hosted HTTP service plus a CLI, not an npm package.
- Does it include a frontend? No. The repository contains no UI code; build your own client against `docs/api.md` and `docs/openapi.json`.
- Does it have user accounts? No. Registration, login, OAuth, history, and favorites were removed — those belong to the caller.
- What database does it use? None. The engine is stateless pure calculation.
- Is Redis required? No, in any environment. Without it each instance keeps its own in-memory chart cache; results are identical, only the hit rate drops.
- Can it run without an AI API key? Yes. Charting, drawing, and divination are deterministic and never touch AI; interpretation falls back to the `mock` provider.
- Which endpoints require authentication? None of the business endpoints. Only `/api-docs` (Basic Auth) and `/metrics` (bearer token).
- Is it production-ready? Yes. Stateless means scaling out is just more processes and deployments can be destroyed and rebuilt at will. Read `PRODUCTION.md` before deploying.
- How do I run it fastest? `./bazi setup && ./bazi doctor && ./bazi stack up`.

## Known Algorithmic Boundaries

These are deliberate choices, documented in `.claude/skills/bazi-cli/SKILL.md`. They never raise an
error — a wrong assumption simply yields a different chart:

- True solar time participates in charting by default, whenever the birth location resolves to a longitude and the timezone offset is known. Pass `trueSolarTime: false` to fall back to clock time. `chartTime.used` reports the instant actually charted; `chartTime.trueSolarTime.clockTime` preserves the original.
- Because of that correction, `birthMinute` can change the hour pillar when the corrected instant crosses a two-hour branch boundary.
- The location table holds 33 cities; an unrecognized name silently skips correction. Coordinate strings always work.
- The year pillar changes at 立春 (Start of Spring) and the month pillar at solar terms, both to the exact instant — on a boundary day the hour decides both.
- Late-Zi hour (23:00–23:59) does not roll the day pillar, while the hour pillar already uses the next day's stem.
- Leap months fold into the base month for Zi Wei charts.
- The chart cache key covers every charting input: year-month-day-hour-gender plus suffixes for birth location, minute, timezone, and the `trueSolarTime` toggle. Any new charting input must be added to it.

## Limitations

- Treat output as entertainment, cultural exploration, or prototype data.
- Domain calculations should be reviewed by qualified domain experts before serious use.
- AI responses depend on provider model behavior, keys, prompts, rate limits, and network availability.
- Production deployment requires HTTPS termination, `DOCS_PASSWORD`, a correct `TRUST_PROXY` hop count, and monitoring.
- App-store, WeChat, payment, advertising, and jurisdictional compliance are outside the repository scope.
